title: Synthesis-guided cache + batching canvas with narrative walkthrough cards
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a synthesis-guided configuration canvas in the Redwood Console that helps engineers compose caching + batching policies. The canvas combines: (1) recommended micro-presets synthesized from historical workload signatures, (2) an interactive narrative walkthrough (card-based) that explains trade-offs for latency/cost/quality, (3) inline scenario simulation with estimated token-cost and percentile latency projections, and (4) guardrail suggestions with rollback playbooks. Goal: reduce time-to-safe-config for engineers and surface explainability so PMs/DevEx can approve rollouts faster.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma mockups for desktop and compact tablet + annotated interaction specs
Clickable prototype that simulates 3 workload archetypes (chat, search, rerank) with cost/latency preview
Card-based narrative UI that surfaces the top 3 synthesized presets and one custom builder path
Guardrail panel with autogenerated rollback steps and threshold suggestions (soft/hard)
Design notes for accessibility (contrast, keyboard flow) and localization placeholders
Design handoff package including tokens, component variants, and CSS snippets
design_notes: Synthesis engine will propose presets by clustering recent request traces; canvas shows confidence band for each preset
Cards should be scannable: title, one-line rationale, delta cost %, 95th-latency impact, and risk indicator
Inline simulator uses precomputed cost model (tokens * model-unit-price + batching amortized overhead) and a synthetic latency model derived from runtime telemetry
Provide explicit ‘Explain’ expanders that show which signals drove the recommendation (prefix reuse, average seq len, percent repeated prompts)
Include a compact heatstrip visualization for distribution of sequence lengths and KV-hit ratio
Enable quick A/B rollout button that wires into the Console rollouts flow with prefilled guardrails

2026-03-13 — Design critique: Feedback to reduce cognitive load by hiding advanced knobs behind a ‘tweak’ drawer and keep card default actions to Apply / Simulate / Explain. Add aria-labels for card actions.

review_feedback: PM (Priya): Love the narrative cards but request clearer separation between cost estimate (best-effort) vs SLA guarantees — label them explicitly
Eng (Marco Ruiz): Simulator looks plausible; ensure the offline cost model matches billing team’s per-token tables — added dependency BILL-032
Security (Nina Kapoor): Guardrail suggestions must not expose raw customer traces in the UI; ensure only aggregated signals are surfaced
DevEx (Olive Bennett): Recommend adding a CLI copy of the chosen preset so infra teams can reproduce outside Console
decisions: Surface only aggregated telemetry signals (percentiles, hit ratios) — no raw request text in UI
Default canvas view shows top 3 synthesized presets and one ‘Custom’ starter; advanced knobs are collapsed
Simulations are best-effort projections and will include an explicit confidence band tooltip
Rollout action will pre-populate canary groups and attach an automatic rollback playbook if any hard-guardrail triggers
